title: ChannelForge Lineup Category Policy
description: Shape contract for data/lineup/categories.json. This validates structure only. It intentionally does not enumerate specific category names, since the set of categories is expected to vary per deployment and change over time.

_comment.description: Optional documentation note. Ignored by any reader of this file.

primary_categories.description: Ordered list of category labels that make up the primary lineup.

exclude_groups.description: Optional list of provider group labels to drop entirely before categorization.

adult_policy.description: Optional free-text policy note for adult content handling.

international_policy.description: Optional free-text policy note for international content handling.
